## PR Checklist
- [ ] The commit message follows our guidelines: https://github.com/tailwatch/tailwatch/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md

---

## Summary
A concise summary of the changes included in this pull request.

## Description
Provide a detailed description of the changes introduced by this PR. Include motivation, context, and any technical decisions made.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bugfix
- [ ] New Feature
- [ ] Code style update (formatting, local variables)
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, no api changes)
- [ ] Build related changes
- [ ] Continuous Integration related changes
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Other... Please describe:

## Testing Instructions
1. Step-by-step instructions on how to test these changes locally.
2. What edge cases or environments were verified?
3. Commands run (e.g., `npm run test`, `npm run build`).

## Final Checklist
- [ ] Code meets project style and formatting guidelines.
- [ ] Self-review completed prior to submission. (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] Relevant documentation created or updated. (for bug fixes / features)
- [ ] Tested locally on a fresh WordPress environment
